unit.why: An entry in an anthology section 'on yeshivot' quoting the Yeven Metzulah's general historical description of the yeshiva system in old Poland: study schedule, pilpul, the Lublin and Yaroslav fairs, matchmaking and the honour paid to the rosh yeshiva. It describes customs, not a narrative of particular events happening to someone.
unit.boundary_note: Ends the letter yod section ('סליק אות י'); the next division opens a new section on honour (כבוד) with an Ari story.
